reason: The sandboxed document extractor (#243): createRequire(<cwd>/package.json).resolve('unpdf') only resolves unpdf's path, so the child's --allow-fs-read can name that one directory; it loads nothing. Inside the reader directory, behind the reader capability.

The sandboxed extractor's child process (#243): it imports unpdf from the entry path its parent resolved, because under --permission it may read only its own script and that directory, so a bare specifier cannot resolve. It runs with an empty environment and parses one document.
